newsitem.title: AFGHANISTAN: Taleban launch offensive in central Afghanistan.
newsitem.headline: Taleban launch offensive in central Afghanistan.

text.p: The purist Islamic Taleban launched an attack on forces loyal to the opposition alliance in central Afghanistan on Sunday and captured four districts, Taleban fighters said.

"The attack started at 4 o'clock this morning on the fighters of Hezb-e-Wahadat (Party of Unity -- one of the three main parties in the opposition alliance)," Taleban commander Juma Uddin told Reuters.
"We launched a two-pronged attack on Wahdat forces at Shibber Pass. We have sent around 400 reinforcements and several tanks to Shibber," he said.
The Shibber Pass, 180 km (110 miles) northwest of Kabul, is controlled by the mainly Shi'ite Hezb-e-Wahadat.
The pass leads to the opposition stronghold of Bamiynn in central Afghanistan and from there to the north of the country.
